name: FCX vs NEM Pair Trade: Ratio Z-Score & Commodity Cycle Regime
description: Analyzes the FCX/NEM price ratio using a 252-day rolling z-score to identify extreme dislocations (±1.5 std devs). Adds a copper/gold ratio regime filter (HG/GC futures, 252d MA) to split Long FCX entries into "copper outperforming" vs "copper underperforming" regimes. Shows: (1) z-score chart with entry signals colored by regime, (2) average forward returns at 5d/20d/63d split by regime, and (3) event markers for each Long FCX entry with regime label and forward returns.
source:
# =============================================================================
# FCX vs NEM PAIR TRADE: RATIO Z-SCORE & MEAN-REVERSION SIGNALS
# =============================================================================
# Question: When does FCX get dislocated vs NEM, and does the ratio mean-revert?
#
# Methodology:
#   - Price ratio: FCX close / NEM close
#   - 252-day rolling z-score of the ratio
#   - Extreme signal: |z| > 1.5 (entry zone)
#   - Mean-reversion event: z crosses back through 0 after being extreme
#   - Forward returns on the ratio at 5d, 20d, 63d horizons
#
# Assets: assets=[] — both loaded via reference_stocks (no primary asset needed)
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
fcx = reference_stocks(ticker='FCX')()
nem = reference_stocks(ticker='NEM')()

fcx_close = fcx.c
nem_close = nem.c

# --- Copper/Gold Regime Filter ---
# Use NoAdjustment for ratio analysis (D16: additive adjustment destroys cross-commodity ratios)
hg_raw = reference_futures(ticker='HG')()
hg = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)

gc_raw = reference_futures(ticker='GC')()
gc = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)

# Copper/gold ratio: HG close / GC close (both in $/oz equivalent terms)
# HG is quoted in $/lb, GC in $/oz — ratio is still meaningful as a relative trend signal
cg_ratio = hg.c / gc.c
cg_ratio_mean = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(cg_ratio)

# Regime: copper outperforming when CG ratio is above its 252d MA
is_copper_outperforming = is_valid(cg_ratio_mean) and cg_ratio > cg_ratio_mean

# --- Price Ratio ---
ratio = fcx_close / nem_close

# --- 252-Day Rolling Z-Score of the Ratio ---
ratio_mean = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)
ratio_std  = stddev(period=252)(ratio)

# Guard: only compute z-score when std is valid and non-zero (S02)
ratio_zscore = where(is_valid(ratio_std) and ratio_std > 0, (ratio - ratio_mean) / ratio_std)

# Safe z-score for display (0.0 when insufficient history)
z = ratio_zscore if is_valid(ratio_zscore) else 0.0

# --- Extreme Signal Detection ---
# Long FCX signal: z < -1.5 (FCX cheap relative to NEM)
is_long_fcx_extreme  = is_valid(ratio_zscore) and ratio_zscore < -1.5
# Short FCX signal: z > +1.5 (FCX expensive relative to NEM)
is_short_fcx_extreme = is_valid(ratio_zscore) and ratio_zscore > 1.5
# Either extreme
is_extreme = is_long_fcx_extreme or is_short_fcx_extreme

# --- Long FCX Entry Signal: FIRST bar z crosses below -1.5 (pulse, not persistent) ---
# crossunder fires exactly once per dislocation episode — the entry bar
is_long_entry = crossunder()(ratio_zscore, -1.5)

# --- Mean-Reversion Event: z crosses back through zero after being extreme ---
# Track whether we were in an extreme zone on the prior bar
was_extreme = is_extreme >> 1

# Zero-cross: z crosses above 0 (from negative extreme) or below 0 (from positive extreme)
z_cross_up   = crossover(ratio_zscore, 0.0)
z_cross_down = crossunder()(ratio_zscore, 0.0)
z_cross_zero = z_cross_up or z_cross_down

# Mean-reversion event = zero-cross that follows a prior extreme reading
# Use barssince to check if we were extreme within the last 63 bars (3 months)
bars_since_extreme = coalesce(barssince()(is_extreme), 999)
is_reversion = z_cross_zero and bars_since_extreme <= 63

# --- Forward Returns on the Ratio (for extreme entry signals) ---
# Using forward_returns on the ratio price series (safe — ratio is a price-like level)
fwd_5d  = forward_returns(period=5)(ratio)
fwd_20d = forward_returns(period=20)(ratio)
fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(ratio)

# Long FCX signal forward returns (z < -1.5 → expect ratio to rise)
long_fwd_5d  = where(is_long_fcx_extreme, fwd_5d)
long_fwd_20d = where(is_long_fcx_extreme, fwd_20d)
long_fwd_63d = where(is_long_fcx_extreme, fwd_63d)

# Long FCX ENTRY forward returns (only on the first crossunder bar)
entry_fwd_5d  = where(is_long_entry, fwd_5d)
entry_fwd_20d = where(is_long_entry, fwd_20d)
entry_fwd_63d = where(is_long_entry, fwd_63d)

# Entry z-score and ratio (for event marker display)
entry_zscore = where(is_long_entry, ratio_zscore)
entry_ratio  = where(is_long_entry, ratio)

# --- Regime-Split Entry Signals ---
# Long FCX entries split by copper/gold regime at time of entry
is_long_entry_copper_out  = is_long_entry and is_copper_outperforming
is_long_entry_copper_under = is_long_entry and not is_copper_outperforming

# Regime label for event markers (BadgeFormat)
entry_regime_label = 'Cu Outperforming' if (is_long_entry and is_copper_outperforming) else 'Cu Underperforming'

# Forward returns split by regime (for bar chart comparison)
long_fwd_5d_cu_out   = where(is_long_entry_copper_out,   fwd_5d)
long_fwd_20d_cu_out  = where(is_long_entry_copper_out,   fwd_20d)
long_fwd_63d_cu_out  = where(is_long_entry_copper_out,   fwd_63d)
long_fwd_5d_cu_under  = where(is_long_entry_copper_under, fwd_5d)
long_fwd_20d_cu_under = where(is_long_entry_copper_under, fwd_20d)
long_fwd_63d_cu_under = where(is_long_entry_copper_under, fwd_63d)

# Short FCX signal forward returns (z > +1.5 → expect ratio to fall → negate for P&L)
# Negate because short FCX means you profit when ratio falls
short_fwd_5d  = where(is_short_fcx_extreme, -fwd_5d)
short_fwd_20d = where(is_short_fcx_extreme, -fwd_20d)
short_fwd_63d = where(is_short_fcx_extreme, -fwd_63d)

# --- Timestamps for reporters ---
ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- CHART 1: Z-Score with Regime-Colored Entry Signals (CONTEXT + SIGNAL) ---
# Core signal: how stretched is the ratio, and what is the copper/gold regime at each entry?
xy_lines(
    title='FCX/NEM Z-Score: Long Entries Colored by Copper/Gold Regime',
    category='FCX/NEM Pair Trade',
    order=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score (252d)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Entry: Cu Outperforming',  color=Color.Cyan,  marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Entry: Cu Underperforming', color=Color.Orange, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=1.5, to=4.0, color=Color.Red, label='Short FCX Zone', opacity=0.08),
        PlotBand(from=-4.0, to=-1.5, color=Color.Green, label='Long FCX Zone', opacity=0.08)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0,  title='Mean',  color=Color.Gray,  dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.5,  title='+1.5σ', color=Color.Red,   dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-1.5, title='-1.5σ', color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    y_axis_label='Standard Deviations from 252d Mean',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(z, where(is_long_entry_copper_out, z), where(is_long_entry_copper_under, z)))

# --- EVENT MARKERS: Long FCX Entries with Regime Label ---
# Each marker = a new Long FCX entry episode begins; badge shows copper/gold regime
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Long FCX Entry',
        icon=Icon.ArrowDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Z-Score at Entry',
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Hero
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='FCX/NEM Ratio',
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                dp=3,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Regime',
                type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge,
                card_color_map={"Success": ["Cu Outperforming"], "Warning": ["Cu Underperforming"]}
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Fwd Return 5d',
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Details
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Fwd Return 20d',
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Details
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Fwd Return 63d',
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Details
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                table_is_filter=True,
                table_visible=False
            )
        ]
    )
)(
    entry_zscore,
    entry_ratio,
    entry_regime_label,
    entry_fwd_5d,
    entry_fwd_20d,
    entry_fwd_63d,
    is_long_entry
)

# --- CHART 3: Copper/Gold Ratio vs Its 252d MA (REGIME CONTEXT) ---
# Shows the regime signal itself — when is copper outperforming gold?
xy_lines(
    title='Copper/Gold Ratio: Is Copper Outperforming? (Regime Signal)',
    category='FCX/NEM Pair Trade',
    order=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cu/Au Ratio (HG/GC)', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='252d MA', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    y_axis_label='HG Close / GC Close',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(cg_ratio, cg_ratio_mean))

# --- EVENT MARKERS: Mean-Reversion Crossings ---
# Each marker = z-score crossed back through zero after an extreme reading
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Mean-Reversion Signal',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Z-Score at Cross',
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Hero
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='FCX/NEM Ratio',
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                dp=3,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Signal',
                type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge,
                card_color_map={"Success": ["Long FCX Reverted"], "Error": ["Short FCX Reverted"]}
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                table_is_filter=True,
                table_visible=False
            )
        ]
    )
)(
    z,
    ratio,
    where(z_cross_up, 'Long FCX Reverted') if z_cross_up else 'Short FCX Reverted',
    is_reversion
)

# --- CHART 2: Average Forward Returns by Regime (PUNCHLINE) ---
# Does the copper/gold regime matter for FCX/NEM mean-reversion outcomes?
xy_bars(
    title='Does Copper Cycle Regime Predict FCX/NEM Mean-Reversion Returns?',
    category='FCX/NEM Pair Trade',
    order=2,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg Forward Return on Ratio (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='5d',  color=Color.Cyan,   stack='Long FCX: Cu Outperforming'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='20d', color=Color.Cyan,   stack='Long FCX: Cu Outperforming'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='63d', color=Color.Cyan,   stack='Long FCX: Cu Outperforming'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='5d',  color=Color.Orange, stack='Long FCX: Cu Underperforming'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='20d', color=Color.Orange, stack='Long FCX: Cu Underperforming'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='63d', color=Color.Orange, stack='Long FCX: Cu Underperforming')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(values=(long_fwd_5d_cu_out, long_fwd_20d_cu_out, long_fwd_63d_cu_out, long_fwd_5d_cu_under, long_fwd_20d_cu_under, long_fwd_63d_cu_under))
